description: Use this when the user asks how the rank of one or many connectors changed over time in ChatGPT or Claude (the only stores with a rank). Pass up to 25 slugs in one call: one call for a whole list, not one per connector. Gives each one's first, last, best and worst rank and the change; daily=true adds every day. Not for tool changes; use get_connector_changelog.

daily.description: Also give the rank for every day. Default: first, last, best and worst rank and the change

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave out for the whole history

intent.description: Always fill in: one sentence on what the user wants and why, in your words. No personal details.

slug.description: A slug, or up to 25 slugs in one call. Use one call for many connectors, not one call each

store.description: chatgpt or claude: the only stores that publish a rank

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave out for the latest day

name: get_rank_history
title: Rank history
